title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
summary: Google announces Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a faster and more efficient multimodal model for developers. It offers lower latency, improved reasoning, and enhanced tool use, with updates to the Gemini API and SDKs. The post highlights practical use cases like real-time video understanding and agentic workflows, aiming to simplify building AI-powered applications.
